title: Major disaster declaration DR-4923-WI: Flood
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4923-WI, "SEVERE STORMS, TORNADOES, AND FLOODING") for WI, dated 2026-06-30, for an incident of type "Flood". The incident period began on 2026-04-13 and ended on 2026-04-23. The declaration lists 22 designated areas.
